deadline.value: Priority application deadline is January 15 for Fall 2027 PhD applicants; the application deadline is March 15.
deadline.quote: January 15 – Priority application deadline for Ph.D. students.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test applies to computer science.

supervisor.value: An optional endorsement from a tenure-track CS faculty member who agrees to be the initial adviser is accepted.
supervisor.quote: a letter of endorsement from a tenure-track member of the MSU Computer Science faculty who agrees to serve as the applicant's initial research advisor

funding.value: Incoming PhD students are typically funded with teaching assistantships for the first year, then usually research assistantships.
funding.quote: Incoming Ph.D. students are typically funded with teaching assistantships for their first year.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field.
entry_route.quote: a previous Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a closely related discipline

gre_general.value: The department says the GRE is optional; scores can be uploaded.

toefl_min.value: The department requires TOEFL iBT 4.5 on the new scale, stricter than the graduate school minimum.
toefl_min.quote: at least 4.5 on TOEFL internet-based test (at least 86 in the previous scoring system)

english_waiver.value: Applicants with a previous degree from an English-speaking university are exempt; the page does not say whether an Indian English-medium degree counts.
english_waiver.quote: who do not have a previous degree from an English-speaking university, must demonstrate proficiency of the English language

notes: There is no PhD in data science; the data science degree here is an MS run by Mathematical Sciences. The department GPA minimum is 3.30 for the last two years.
